caption: The drawing depicts a pair of metal objects positioned side by side, joined at the top by two curved brown handles made up of segmented sections, suggesting they might be made of wood or wrapped leather. The objects are primarily metallic in appearance, presenting shades of gray, silver, and bluish tones, with intricate mechanical parts visible. The left object has a more gear-like, textured circular design with fine details and small holes, while the right object is smooth with rounded decorative engravings and raised patterns. Both objects have large, round loops at the top and feature short lengths of metal chain hanging from below. The background is plain and off-white, and the artist’s signature, "Arthur E. Reynolds," is written in small letters beneath the objects, slightly to the right.
title: Bit
